title: The Same Old Menu?
description: Are you stuck in a food loop, or a flavor adventurer?

questions.text: The waiter hands you a massive menu. You:

choices.label: Close it immediately. 'I'm having my usual, please.'
Briefly scan, then order your signature dish.
Order whatever everyone else seems to be getting.
Look for the weirdest, newest, or 'Chef's Special'.

questions.text: You're at your favorite stall. They're out of your usual order.

choices.label: Leave immediately. I'll eat somewhere else.
Panic, then order the slightly less great second-best option.
Ask the vendor what's popular today and take that.
Finally! A valid excuse to try something completely new.

questions.text: Someone offers you a bite of a very strange, exotic dish.

choices.label: 'No thanks. I like knowing what's in my mouth.'
Hesitate. Try it only if they look alive after swallowing.
Wait and see if others try it. Follow the majority.
Grab the spoon before they finish the offer.

questions.text: When picking a restaurant, you prioritize:

choices.label: Guaranteeing I know exactly what the food tastes like.
A proven winner I've enjoyed before (maybe 1-2 times).
Somewhere I can just order whatever is highly rated.
Uniqueness. I must experience a new flavor profile.

questions.text: You finally tried a new dish, and you actually loved it!

choices.label: Great. That was risky. Now, back to my usual next time.
Awesome. This new dish might become my occasional alternate.
Nice. I will remember to tell people to order this one.
Exciting! Time to never order it again and try another new one.
